serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Are you sure it’s a good place? It’s quite far away from the supermarket.
You: I think I saw her once coming this way. She must live nearby…
Bot: If you say so.
#bot.Expression.VeryAngry
You: Yeah, right. Try not being openly hostile. Your face says that you are ready to fight…
Bot: I will try.
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: Better?
You: A little, but you still look angry.
Bot: I want my displeasure to be visible.
You: Alright then…
Damn, that cashier really got under {f_botName}’s skin.
It might be a lost cause…
You: Here she comes!
